end.summary:
Ira interpreted position-time graphs as motion stories; this was shown on a why/new-situation question.
They practised reading v-t graphs, including slope as acceleration and area as distance.
They identified rest, constant velocity, speeding up, and stopping from graph segments.
A graph-line mix-up about moving downhill was corrected: a decreasing position means returning toward the start.
Teach-back was not passed; v-t slope interpretation needs checking for consistency next time.
end.parentNote: Asha practised turning graph segments into motion stories with Ira, using slope, time, and area calculations. Ira used the position-time slope idea and described rest, cruising, speeding up, and stopping; the downhill mix-up was corrected later by linking a decreasing position to returning toward the start. At home, ask Ira to describe one position-time and one velocity-time graph aloud, including what the slope means and which parts still need checking.

Haan, cycling wali baat se confusion bilkul dikhta hai: pahaadi se neeche aate hue bhi aap aage badh sakte hain. X-t graph ki upar-neeche line road ki shape nahi, position ka badalna dikhati hai. Line neeche aaye toh starting point se position badh rahi hai ya ghat rahi hai?

Matlab... jab line neeche aa rahi hai, toh position ghat rahi hai, toh auto starting point ki taraf wapas jaa raha hai. Par pahaadi pe toh aisa thodi hota hai, neeche utarte waqt bhi aage hi badhte hain. Toh shayad yeh graph... auto seedha jaake wapas laut raha hai? Jaise aage gaya phir reverse maara?

Haan, aapne farq pakda: pahaadi se neeche utarna aur starting point ki taraf lautna alag baatein hain. Is x-t graph mein position badhti, phir ghathti hai; road pahaadi thi ya seedhi, yeh graph nahi batata. Ab cricket ka worm graph sochiye: aakhri paanch overs mein Team A ki line zyada steep ho, toh runs ke baare mein kya pata chalta hai, aur yeh x-t graph jaisa kaise hai?
Arre, wo line zyada steep hai na, matlab jaldi jaldi runs ban rahe hain, jaise run rate high hai. X-t graph mein bhi slope velocity hota hai na, isme slope run rate hoga. Simple!

Haan, zyada steep line ka matlab aakhri paanch overs mein runs tez bane. Aapne dono graphs ka link bhi pakda: x-t mein slope velocity, runs-overs mein slope run rate. Ab v-t graph mein slope kya batata hai?
